const.knownPendingRelease: Observe the exact retained cell after a returned canonical pending-release step; fault-held cell remains charged.
const.ambiguousPendingRelease: A wrapper throw followed by null is not pending-release authority; preserve purpose and original fault.
const.reentry: A cancelled or retained-closing worker preparation never reopens.
const.unusedRecordRefusal: A canonical reserveRecord refusal with no original cell result keeps an unused-cell close path; a thrown or ambiguous absence remains retained.
